## About This Person
Name: Pierre-Adrien LAIR
Current Role: Senior Lead Analytics & AI, and Director of the AI LAB at Converteo (Paris, France)

Specialization: Applied AI engineering (LLM agents, MCP servers, agent skills), analytics measurement, enterprise client advisory

## Professional Summary
Pierre-Adrien is a Senior Lead with 12 years of experience in digital and data consulting, holding a dual role at Converteo:
1. Senior Lead Measurement & Analytics - owns the Analytics & Conversion vision for a 150+ consultant practice and advises large enterprises on measurement challenges.
2. Director of the Converteo AI LAB - runs the entity that centralises the firm's agentic expertise, arbitrates the AI project portfolio, and industrialises the production of agents, skills and MCP servers for 450 employees.

He builds and ships LLM systems in production: multi-step agents (Google ADK), MCP servers, reusable sub-agents and skills, browser automation, and the internal platforms that expose them to teams (Next.js, Cloud Run, Firestore, GCP CI/CD).
